findings.title: Competing snapshots are not one current match list
findings.detail: Historical desks contain different windows, IDs, verification assertions and prices. They remain archives; none is imported as verified merely because a status string says so. The canonical dataset has its own evidence and coverage limits.

findings.status: resolved in canonical model; archive retained
findings.title: Missing ratings can create a spurious legacy edge
findings.detail: v3 substitutes 58.0 for missing ratings and subtracts it from the other side. A one-sided measurement is not a measured matchup edge. Canonical model refuses any price when either required record is missing.

findings.title: Published clocks must not be guessed as UTC
findings.detail: OLBG relative Today/Tomorrow clocks, WST clocks without timezone and F1 My time/Track time are not exact UTC. Canonical UTC cells stay blank unless explicitly published or deterministically converted from an explicit offset.

findings.title: High confidence has no measured calibration here
findings.detail: Legacy thresholds and labelled constants do not establish predictive reliability. The new independent model has no temporal out-of-sample evaluation; it issues Low experimental estimates only, not unsupported High claims.

findings.title: Legacy probability/price clipping changes the estimate
findings.detail: The original to_odds clamps both probabilities and odds. Canonical fair prices use 1/p without clamping, with a separately derived American display and an unrounded target-band test.

findings.title: Static snapshots outlive kickoff
findings.detail: Historical generators can leave scheduled dates and predictions displayed after the stored start. Canonical sources expire after six hours; elapsed starts are not offered as pre-match picks, and the browser rechecks expiry without waiting for a deployment.

findings.title: Fair-price eligibility is not a bookmaker quote
findings.detail: −250 means decimal 1.40; +10000 means 101.00. The fair-probability band is about 0.99%–71.43%. A >70% probability cutoff would admit only a narrow slice, so that is NOT this release’s confidence rule. No bookmaker prices were verified; quote/edge fields stay blank. No alternate is searched to manufacture confidence.

findings.title: Old NHL record is internally inconsistent
findings.detail: The f71557b5 Boston–Nashville row says Nashville 3-3-2 and 9 points. Three wins plus two overtime losses is 8 points. The freshly read NHL table instead shows 3-2-3, 9 points, 8 games. Old text is not inherited.

findings.title: PDC matchup verification incomplete
findings.detail: Inspected PDC extraction chunks returned consent text rather than a usable fixture schedule. OLBG darts cards are discovery only; accepted matchup, start, price and confidence fields remain blank.

findings.title: Previously cited PGA article returns page-not-found text
findings.detail: The facts-and-figures URL could not support the prior claims in this retrieval. The current event date/course are instead checked on the PGA TOUR schedule; fields and golfer predictions are not recovered from the missing article.

findings.title: EHF schedule publication predates matchday
findings.detail: The retrieved playing-times PDF explicitly says Status: July 29, 2026. The document supports its listed pairings but cannot establish current amendments, availability or form. These listings are unpriced pending a current feed.

findings.title: EuroLeague record contradiction quarantined
findings.detail: The Round 7 preview describes Real Madrid as 3-3 overall and 1-4 away. Four road losses cannot fit three total losses in the same scope. The pairing/time remain sourced; Madrid’s rating input and that match price are blank.

findings.title: Partial automation is not full multi-sport coverage
findings.detail: Continuous structured adapters currently cover NHL, MLB and NBA schedules. Other official checks are explicit unparsed/partial gaps; cached document extracts expire and are never stamped as refreshed by a failed request. No worldwide completeness claim.

findings.title: Respect OLBG crawler restrictions
findings.detail: OLBG robots disallows /api/, hidden JSON storage, and the Python-urllib client. The scheduled collector identifies its library and obeys these restrictions. It does not call hidden endpoints, rotate identities or treat denied access as zero events.

findings.title: Regular-season baseball data is not current postseason form
findings.detail: The MLB inputs are explicitly 2026 regular-season W/L and runs. No probable starters, current lineup, last-match report or postseason adjustment was verified. All six originated market families/lines per game remain Low and experimental.

findings.title: Tennis orders of play contain non-exact and retired entries
findings.detail: Followed by and Not before are not exact starts. The Osaka sheet also shows a Ruzic–Day 6-4 0-0 RET entry; it is not offered as an upcoming match. No timezone, tournament name absent from extraction, player form or recent score is inferred from a bracket.

findings.title: Volleyball competition identity conflict
findings.detail: The PlusLiga games request redirects to TAURON Liga; the SKRA calendar likewise carries that heading. Two opponent/date listings are retained as document facts, but competition, venue, UTC time and all prices remain blank.

findings.title: Field sports require a complete runner model
findings.detail: F1 practice/qualifying/race and golf tournament listings are event cards, not two-sided matches. A complete field, withdrawals and placement/dead-heat rules are required before originating outright or placement prices.
